convexSpendingDecision.explicitOperatorDecision: Maintain the existing USD 50 monthly Convex usage spending disable threshold for internal testing so Mark's low-volume evaluation is less likely to disable the backend unexpectedly.
convexSpendingDecision.scopeLimit: This accepts only the existing Convex team usage spending disable threshold as the internal-testing hard shutoff. It is not a per-run price, not a target spend, not Vercel or Sandbox cost evidence, and not production activation authority.

custodyDecision.scope: rollback and value-free secret-custody accountability naming only; no secret read, generation, storage or external delivery is authorized

fastFollowCostLedger.reason: The USD 50 threshold protects internal testing continuity, but it does not explain the end-to-end economics of one CAD run.
outputsRequired: cost per stopped or failed CAD run
recommended internal cap per test window
recommended fee per production CAD run
fastFollowCostLedger.nextSourceSlice: source-only CAD run cost ledger packet after Auth/session and upload/conversion instrumentation is available

deploymentCommandReview.reason: The exact source SHA, disabled rollback SHA, env-file custody receipt and future UTC window still need to be bound before a development deployment.

deployTemplate.command: npx --no-install convex deploy --env-file .local/cad-convex/dev-auth-edt/convex-deployment.env --typecheck try --codegen enable --message cad-dev-auth-edt:<source-sha>

disabledRollbackTemplate.command: git -C <worktree> checkout <disabled-rollback-sha> && npx --no-install convex deploy --env-file .local/cad-convex/dev-auth-edt/convex-deployment.env --typecheck try --codegen enable --message cad-dev-auth-disabled-rollback:<disabled-rollback-sha>

mustBeReplacedBeforeDeployment: future UTC deployment and rollback deadline

freshRunWindow.selectionPolicy: pick a future UTC window only after the exact deploy and rollback command digests are bound to reviewed source

remainingGates.requirement: bind exact development deploy command, rollback command, source SHA, disabled rollback SHA and command digest before development deployment
accept one fresh future UTC run window for a single development-only attempt
measure and publish end-to-end per-run economics before deciding production CAD run pricing or broader tester budget

nextSafeAction.scope: source-only exact command binding and one proposed fresh UTC window using the accepted USD 50 Convex threshold and Amina backup custodian
nextSafeAction.stopBefore: development env mutation, deployment, live run, upload activation or conversion
